name: Sumo Bumpers
hook: Bump everyone off the ring before it crumbles.
how: Roll your round bumper into the others to knock them into the sea, while the ring falls away from the edge in. Last one on wins the round; first to 3 rounds wins the match.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to roll and Space to dash, or the touch stick and Dash button
uses: The host's browser works out every bump; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
The host counts who fell in and who won; the crumbling ring runs on the round's clock.
Bots fill the ring until enough people join.
Every bumper and every falling piece of the ring is the same for everyone.
The players who won the most matches, on the results card.
ideas: Make it a pillow fight on a floating bed
Add a power-up that makes you giant for 5 seconds
Add ice patches that make you slide further
